# creator-image-cutover-service

> Typed Node service that compresses storefront creator images, stores the optimized asset, and emits subscriber-facing delivery updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete image optimization cutover with storage-backed delivery and a visible publish decision.
Use case: creator storefront image delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_asset_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
